purpose: Navigation registry for the belief atlas. Keeps political ideologies, religious traditions and nonreligious worldviews addressable without collapsing them into one taxonomy.

layers.name: Political ideologies
layers.coordinate_system: three-dimensional political cube: economic organization × state authority × social-cultural openness

layers.name: Religious traditions and worldviews
layers.coordinate_system: three-dimensional worldview cube: communal-individual × institutional-experiential × immanent-transcendent
layers.political_separation: no political score is implied by religious identity

navigation_policy: Every entry has a stable slug and is searchable, hoverable and clickable in the 3D space. Clicking a mapped belief opens its canonical individual record page. The classic four-quadrant political compass remains available as the x/y slice of the political cube.
research_principles: attach primary and scholarly sources to definitions
avoid treating labels as descriptions of every adherent
make analytical coordinates explicit rather than presenting them as objective measurements
